issues.t: Timing chain guides break on the 2.0L turbo
issues.sym: A whine or rattle from the front of the engine, worst on cold starts, timing or camshaft fault codes, a Drivetrain Malfunction warning, or sudden loss of power and stalling.
issues.why: The plastic timing chain guides on the early 428i's 2.0L turbo engine turn brittle and break. The chain can then go slack, skip teeth or snap, which can destroy the engine. Cars built after about February 2015 got revised parts.
issues.next: If you hear a whine or rattle, stop driving it hard and get it inspected right away. Ask for records showing updated chain parts were installed. BMW's extended coverage and a class-action settlement have aged out for most cars, but a dealer can check your VIN.

issues.t: Electric water pump or thermostat fails and the engine overheats
issues.sym: Engine temperature warning, the radiator fan running hard all the time, a reduced-power mode, coolant leaks or a drained battery. A common fault code is 2E83.
issues.why: These engines use an electric water pump that wears out, usually between 50,000 and 100,000 miles. The thermostat is a weak point too and can stick.
issues.next: If the temperature warning comes on, pull over and shut the engine off; driving an overheating engine can ruin it. Replace the thermostat along with the pump.

issues.t: Valve cover gasket leaks oil or the plastic cover cracks
issues.sym: Burning-oil smell, light smoke from around the engine, oil on the spark plugs, or a low-oil warning.
issues.why: The valve cover gasket wears out, and the plastic valve cover itself can warp or crack. It is most common on the 2014-2016 engines but newer engines get it too.
issues.next: Have the leak confirmed. Fix it before oil drips onto the hot exhaust or soaks the ignition parts.

issues.t: Crankcase vent valve fails and the engine whistles
issues.sym: A whistle, howl or squeal at idle, white exhaust smoke, rough running, or new oil leaks at the crankshaft seals.
issues.why: The crankcase vent (PCV) valve is built into the valve cover, and its rubber diaphragm tears. Pressure then builds inside the engine and pushes oil past seals.
issues.next: Have the vent valve tested. Dealers usually replace the whole valve cover; aftermarket repair kits also exist.

issues.t: Oil filter housing gasket leaks oil
issues.sym: Oil dripping at the front of the engine, oil on the drive belt, or a burning-oil smell.
issues.why: The gasket under the oil filter housing hardens and leaks, and the plastic housing can crack. Leaks often show up around 50,000 miles.
issues.next: Fix it soon. Oil on the drive belt can make it slip off and get pulled into the engine. Check the oil level often until it's repaired.

issues.t: Plastic turbo charge pipe cracks and power drops
issues.sym: A loud pop followed by a big loss of power, no boost, a check engine light or a Drivetrain Malfunction warning.
issues.why: The plastic pipe carrying pressurized air from the turbo cracks or blows apart under boost. It happens sooner on tuned cars but also on stock ones.
issues.next: The car can usually be driven gently to a shop. Many owners replace it with a stronger aluminum pipe.

issues.t: Plastic coolant hoses and expansion tank crack and leak
issues.sym: Low-coolant warning, a sweet smell, or coolant spots under the car.
issues.why: Plastic cooling parts get brittle with age. The expansion tank hose is the most common failure, often between 50,000 and 90,000 miles.
issues.next: Check the coolant level every few months. If the engine overheats, stop and have it towed.

issues.t: VANOS solenoid fault causes rough running
issues.sym: Check engine light, rough idle, hesitation, loss of power, a rattle, or limp mode.
issues.why: A VANOS (variable valve timing) solenoid sticks or fails. On these newer engines the solenoids sit at the back of the engine, so they're harder to reach.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Often only the solenoid needs replacing, and sometimes cleaning it fixes the problem.

issues.t: M4 crank hub can spin and knock timing out
issues.sym: Sudden limp mode, a Drivetrain Malfunction warning, hard starting, rough idle, a check engine light and timing or VANOS codes.
issues.why: On the S55 engine in the 2015-2020 M4, the crank hub is held only by friction and can spin on the crankshaft, throwing off engine timing. It is rare on stock cars and more likely on tuned ones.
issues.next: Stop driving if timing warnings appear; running it can damage the engine. Owners of tuned cars often install a locking or keyed crank hub kit.

issues.t: M4 dual-clutch delays engaging Drive or Reverse
issues.sym: After starting, the car hesitates or feels like it's in neutral when you shift from Park or Reverse into Drive, or into Reverse, even though the dash shows the gear.
issues.why: This is a known behavior of the first M4's dual-clutch transmission, usually right after the car has been parked.
issues.next: Wait a few seconds after starting before selecting a gear. A soft clunk into Reverse is normal. If it's getting worse or slipping, have a dealer check for software updates.

issues.t: Water pump connector can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Coolant temperature or water pump warnings, or a burning or electrical smell from the engine bay.
issues.why: The electrical connector on the 2.0L turbo's water pump isn't sealed well enough. Water can get in and short it, which could start a fire.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for recall 24V-608 and park outside until it's fixed. The dealer inspects the pump and connector and adds a protective shield.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Hard starting, stalling, misfires, hesitation or a Drivetrain Malfunction warning.
issues.why: Bad plating inside the in-tank fuel pump can make it fail, and the engine can stall without warning.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Have a dealer confirm recall 15V-189 is done. Fuel pumps can also wear out normally over time.

issues.t: Brake vacuum pump can fail and the pedal gets hard (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal becomes hard and the car takes more effort to stop.
issues.why: Poor lubrication can make the engine-driven brake vacuum pump fail, reducing power braking assist on 2014 428i coupes.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. A hard brake pedal means the brake assist has failed, so the car needs much more force and distance to stop. If it happens while driving, press the pedal firmly, slow down and pull off the road when it's safe. Don't keep driving it: have it towed to a dealer and ask about recall 14V-627.

issues.t: Side curtain airbag inflator weld can fail (recall)
issues.sym: None before a crash.
issues.why: The weld on the head (curtain) airbag inflator can fail, so the airbag may leak and inflate weakly, or the inflator can rupture and throw metal pieces.
issues.next: Have a dealer replace the head airbags under recall 24V-288 as soon as possible.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: None before a crash.
issues.why: A manufacturing defect can make the driver's front airbag inflator burst when it deploys, sending sharp metal pieces toward people inside.
issues.next: Get the driver's airbag replaced under recall 24V-527 right away.

issues.t: Convertible driver airbag timing is set wrong (recall)
issues.sym: None you can notice.
issues.why: A programming error in the airbag control module of some early 2015 428i and 435i convertibles can deploy the driver's airbag at the wrong time.
issues.next: Have the dealer reprogram the airbag module.

issues.t: M4 driveshaft can fail and cut power (recall)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of power to the rear wheels, often with a bang or vibration from under the car.
issues.why: Some M4 driveshafts left the factory without grease in the slip joint (2015-2016), and on 2016-2017 cars the joint between driveshaft and flange can fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for both driveshaft recalls (including 18V-713). The dealer replaces the driveshaft for free.

issues.t: Seat side airbags may not inflate (recall)
issues.sym: None before a crash.
issues.why: The igniter in the seat-mounted side airbags may not fire in a crash.
issues.next: Have the dealer replace the seat airbag modules under recalls 16V-914 and 17V-115.

issues.t: Convertible front seat belts may not lock (recall)
issues.sym: None before a crash.
issues.why: Parts inside the front seat belt retractors on 2018 4 Series convertibles may not match, so the belt might not lock in a crash.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect and replace the belts under recall 17V-507.

issues.t: Crankshaft sensor software can stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls while driving.
issues.why: Some 2019 430i and 440i models got a crankshaft sensor with the wrong firmware, which can make the engine stall.
issues.next: Have the dealer replace the sensor under recall 18V-465.

issues.t: Knee airbags may not inflate correctly (recall)
issues.sym: None before a crash.
issues.why: The driver and passenger knee airbags may have been folded and assembled incorrectly.
issues.next: Have the dealer replace the knee airbag modules under recall 19V-352.

issues.t: M4 fuel injectors can damage the fuel line (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell from the engine bay.
issues.why: Some 2020 M4 injectors were missing a part that damps vibration, which can damage the fuel line and cause a fire risk.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect the injectors and replace them and the fuel rail if needed under recall 20V-666.

issues.t: Rearview camera image can go missing (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera screen stays dark or part of the picture is blocked when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Software in the rearview camera system can fail to show the full image.
issues.next: Check behind the car directly until the dealer updates the software under recall 21V-096.

issues.t: Passenger seat belt locking mode can switch off early (recall)
issues.sym: None you can notice in normal driving.
issues.why: The passenger seat belt's automatic locking retractor (used for child seats) may turn off before the belt fully retracts.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect the belts under recall 21V-554.

issues.t: 48-volt battery connection can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: Usually none. Possibly a burning smell or electrical warnings.
issues.why: On the M440i's mild-hybrid system, the connection between the 48-volt battery and the starter-generator may be assembled poorly, raising resistance and fire risk.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect and fix the connection under recall 20V-761.

issues.t: M4 integrated brake unit can come apart under hard braking (recall)
issues.sym: Brake warnings or loss of brake assist, especially under hard braking.
issues.why: A rotor and shaft inside the integrated brake system of 2021 M4s may not be welded properly and could separate.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Have the dealer replace the integrated brake system under recall 21V-062.

issues.t: Starter relay can corrode and short out (recall)
issues.sym: The car sometimes won't start, or there's a burning smell near the starter.
issues.why: The starter relay on the 430i's 2.0L engine can corrode, overheat and short, raising fire risk.
issues.next: Park outside and away from buildings until the dealer replaces the starter under recall 25V-636.

issues.t: Starter can overheat and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: Trouble starting, a burning smell, or smoke near the engine after starting.
issues.why: Wear inside the starter can make it overheat. Recall 26V-056 covered 2021-2024 cars, and 26V-438 expanded it.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for both starter recalls and park outside until the starter is replaced.

issues.t: Transmission control unit can leak and cut drive power (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive power or transmission warnings.
issues.why: A weld on the cover of the automatic transmission's control unit can let transmission fluid inside, which could lock up the gears.
issues.next: Have the dealer replace the mechatronic unit and fluid if needed under recall 23V-821.

issues.t: Cylinder head cover can crack and leak oil (recall)
issues.sym: Oil smell or smoke from the engine bay, or oil drips under the front of the car.
issues.why: The plastic cylinder head (valve) cover on some 2024 430i convertibles can crack, and oil reaching hot parts could catch fire.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect and replace the cover under recall 23V-863.

issues.t: Starter-generator battery cable can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: The engine may stall, or there may be a burning smell from wiring.
issues.why: The connection between the starter-generator and the battery on some 2025 430i models can loosen, which can stall the engine or overheat the wiring.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect and replace the starter-generator and battery cable as needed under recall 25V-202.

issues.t: Battery cable at the power distribution box may not connect (recall)
issues.sym: The engine may stall, or there may be a burning smell or electrical warnings.
issues.why: On some 2026 430i and M4 models, the positive battery cables may not be properly attached to the power distribution box, which can stall the engine or start a fire.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect and replace the cables and box under recall 25V-643.
